[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): Below the 50% retracement level ($82287.95), facing resistance at the 0.618 level ($81685.66). Observation is needed for confirmation of breakout above swing support ($76624.25) or resistance ($79488.17).
